                        --list-formats)
  --check               validate only; write nothing
  --confirm-exclusions  the user has confirmed the excluded samples (contract
                        template T7)

                        samplesheets (T5)
  --list-formats        print the registered per-assay samplesheet formats and
                        exit
  --model MODEL         the exact model id of the agent executing this stage;
                        recorded in the HISTORY.md entry beside the template

                        none (default): trust the files; stage 00 already
                        checked that every link resolves and carries gzip
                        magic. full: decompress every INCLUDED file before
                        emitting the samplesheet -- the last cheap moment to
                        catch a truncated FASTQ. Above ~10 GB submit this with
                        sbatch; it is not login-node work.
